commands.name: debug.runtime-state

commands.name: debug.main-logs

commands.name: debug.run-targeted-test

commands.name: debug.capture-window

commands.name: debug.inspect-ipc
commands.description: List registered IPC channel names and counts without exposing handlers, payloads, credentials, or user data.

commands.name: debug.inspect-command
commands.description: Inspect one shared automation command definition, including its surface and parameter schema, without executing it.

commands.name: workspace.domain.list
commands.description: List the four canonical SparkAI workspace domains with their public titles, descriptions, icons, plugin projections, and available tool names.

commands.name: workspace.domain.get
commands.description: Return the active project's current workspace domain. Old projects normalize to general.

commands.name: workspace.domain.set
commands.description: Set the active project's workspace domain without remounting the canvas, clearing selection, interrupting tasks, calling a model, or producing charges.

commands.name: project.list
commands.description: List projects and the active project ID.

commands.name: project.switch
commands.description: Switch to an existing project.

commands.name: project.create
commands.description: Create and activate a project in the requested workspace domain; omitted workspaceDomain inherits the current domain.

commands.name: project.rename
commands.description: Rename the active project.

commands.name: canvas.select
commands.description: Atomically replace the canvas selection. Every supplied node ID and primaryId must exist; a mixed valid/stale list fails without changing selection. Use an empty ids array to clear selection.

commands.name: canvas.connect
commands.description: Atomically add one or more exact graph edges. Requirement targets accept multiple image inputs and persist inputRole as SOURCE or REFERENCE; ordinary targets keep one parent. Connections never execute a Requirement. Replacing an existing ordinary parent requires replaceExisting=true.

commands.name: canvas.disconnect
commands.description: Atomically remove the exact listed graph edges. Requirement bindings and their primary compatibility parent are recomputed together. If any requested edge is stale or absent, no edge is removed.

commands.name: canvas.group
commands.description: Atomically group an explicit set of compatible image results or containers into one canonical image container. Unsupported, empty, layer, stale, or locked members fail the whole command; no partial subset is grouped.

commands.name: canvas.dissolve
commands.description: Atomically dissolve one or more exact visible image-container hosts, restore their members as independent canvas results, and preserve provenance relations. Any stale or locked container fails the whole command.

commands.name: canvas.nudge
commands.description: Atomically move explicit nodes or visible container hosts by a relative integer offset. Group members are mapped to their host once and locked nodes fail the whole command.

commands.name: canvas.create-requirement
commands.description: Create one reusable Requirement node with an optional explicit ordered SOURCE/REFERENCE input set. Creation never executes the Requirement and commits the node and all bindings together.

commands.name: canvas.update-requirement
commands.description: Atomically update a Requirement title, instructions, or complete ordered input binding set. expectedRevision is a required compare-and-set guard. Editing imported Skill instructions preserves the import fingerprint as source identity and marks the Skill locally modified.

commands.name: canvas.execute-requirement
commands.description: Validate and execute one current Requirement or Skill through the same frozen Requirement TaskScope path as the GUI, then wait for the current Agent turn to settle. A repeated unchanged run requires confirmedUnchanged=true; a busy Agent or stale revision fails before dispatch.

commands.name: canvas.fit
commands.description: Fit current results into view.

commands.name: canvas.clear
commands.description: Clear failed results or, with explicit confirmation, the whole canvas.

commands.name: canvas.delete-selected
commands.description: Delete selected nodes after explicit user authorization.

commands.name: canvas.create-container
commands.description: Create an image container; omit role for a normal container.

commands.name: canvas.import
commands.description: Copy local images into the active project and place them on the canvas.

commands.name: canvas.import-video
commands.description: Copy authorized local MP4, WebM, MOV, or M4V files into the active project and create independent video result nodes. This command imports existing files only; it does not call a video model or incur generation charges.

commands.name: canvas.generate-video
commands.description: Create one durable asynchronous video task through the independent video adapter. The command writes the project journal before provider dispatch, returns the task and canvas-node state without waiting for the video to finish, resumes polling after restart, and never automatically recreates an ambiguous POST. confirmed=true is required because the upstream Base URL or Token may charge for the request.

commands.args:

commands.description: Import one bounded SKILL.md document as a reusable Skill-backed requirement node. An unchanged exact re-import selects the existing node. commands.name: canvas.export-image
commands.description: Export one canvas image through the native Save dialog as PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, or TIFF. Conversion is local, does not call an image model, and never overwrites the managed source asset. Recorded remote assets are accepted only through the app's public-HTTP(S), redirect-validated managed asset path.

commands.name: requirement-library.list
commands.description: List the installation-local personal Requirement template library across projects. By default the response contains bounded summaries; includeText=true returns the complete stored instructions. Every library item still instantiates as a normal Requirement node, including items carrying Skill metadata.

commands.name: requirement-library.save
commands.description: Save one current canvas Requirement into the installation-local personal template library. expectedRequirementRevision and expectedProjectId guard the source node. Omit templateId to create a new item; when overwriting, pass templateId and its exact expectedTemplateRevision. The complete operation validates before one local CAS write.

commands.name: requirement-library.delete
commands.description: Delete one personal Requirement template only when its exact revision is still current and confirmed=true. This does not delete any Requirement nodes already instantiated on project canvases.

commands.name: requirement-library.use
commands.description: Instantiate one exact personal template revision on the active canvas as a normal Requirement node. Optional ordered SOURCE/REFERENCE bindings and position use the same graph validation and project/canvas compare-and-set guards as direct Requirement creation. This command never executes the Requirement, never calls an image model, and never spends image quota.

commands.name: commerce.template.list
commands.description: List the installation-local commerce template market. Built-in Amazon and AliExpress entries are read-only; personal entries include exact revisions for compare-and-set updates, export, and deletion. This command does not require a canvas selection and never generates images.

commands.name: commerce.template.save
commands.description: Save a reusable structured commerce set plan to the installation-local template market. Omit templateId for a new personal template. A same-name create fails with TEMPLATE_NAME_CONFLICT instead of silently overwriting; use conflictPolicy=copy to create an automatically numbered copy, or re-read the library and pass conflictPolicy=overwrite with the exact personal templateId and expectedTemplateRevision. Source-specific translationItems and canvas saveTarget state are intentionally not accepted or persisted.

commands.name: commerce.template.delete
commands.description: Delete one exact personal commerce template revision. confirmed=true is required. Built-in templates, existing canvas nodes, generated images, and catalog relations are never deleted.

commands.name: commerce.template.import
commands.description: Open the native file picker and import one strict naimage-commerce-template v1 JSON document as a new personal template. Unknown fields, oversized files, invalid plans, and silent overwrites are rejected.

commands.name: commerce.template.export
commands.description: Export one built-in or personal commerce template through the native save dialog. Personal templates require the exact displayed revision; the portable file excludes local IDs, timestamps, source-specific translation cells, canvas paths, and saveTarget state.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.list
commands.description: Read the project-local SKU product catalog with its aggregate CAS revision. The response includes products, variants, SKUs and portable asset relations, but never absolute paths, URLs, blobs or image data.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.upsert
commands.description: Create or update one product aggregate through catalog and product compare-and-set guards. Variant and SKU IDs are Main-owned stable identities; omit them only when creating a new row. An enabled brandStyle is frozen into future Commerce Goals whose SOURCE resolves to this product/SKU; linked logo, packaging and style-reference assets are selected from commerce.catalog.assign records at Goal preview time. This command performs no image generation and never changes canvas nodes.

brandStyle.logoUsage: Keep the original logo artwork, wording, colors and proportions.
brandStyle.modelAppearance: Use the same adult model identity across the listing set.
brandStyle.productAppearance: Keep body geometry, finish and printed markings unchanged.
brandStyle.visualStyle: Clean premium product photography with restrained typography.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.delete
commands.description: Archive one exact product revision. This never deletes canvas nodes or image files and performs no implicit cascade. confirmed=true is still required because the product disappears from the default active catalog view.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.assign
commands.description: Atomically associate 1-200 authoritative canvas images with a product, variant or SKU as a mother image, brand asset or generated result. Inputs accept only nodeId plus zero-based assetIndex; Main resolves managed asset identity and rejects stale, unfinished, unmanaged or path-like input before writing.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.remove
commands.description: Remove one exact material or result relation through catalog and product CAS guards. The underlying canvas node and managed image file are retained.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.review
commands.description: Review one or more generated catalog results through catalog and product compare-and-set guards. linkIds are processed in order against the evolving revisions and may be marked candidate, approved, or rejected; this changes only review state and retains canvas nodes and managed image files.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.compare
commands.description: List A/B comparison groups for retained results sharing the same product ownership, source relation, slot, locale, and role. Different commerce plan runs remain comparable. Groups contain at least two distinct result payloads and preserve exact catalog/product revisions for final selection.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.select
commands.description: Atomically select one exact A/B winner through catalog and product compare-and-set guards. The winner becomes approved and every retained sibling in the recomputed comparison group becomes rejected in one catalog write. No relation, provenance record, canvas node, or managed image file is deleted.

commands.name: commerce.export.preview
commands.description: Preview an Amazon or AliExpress export from the authoritative project SKU catalog. Product-level results inherit to every selected SKU, variant-level results inherit only to matching SKUs, and SKU-level results remain local. Approved results are included by default; includeCandidates=true also includes candidates, while rejected results are always excluded. The response reports dimensions, aspect ratio, Amazon main-image white-edge checks, stable SKU filenames, package counts, and integrity blockers without exposing source paths or writing files.

commands.name: commerce.export.package
commands.description: Re-run the authoritative platform checks and export the selected SKU packages plus a relative-path manifest through a native directory picker. confirmed=true is mandatory. The command never accepts a caller-provided destination path, never mutates managed source images, blocks missing or hash-mismatched assets, and publishes the completed directory atomically.

commands.name: agent.chat
commands.description: Start an idle task and wait for its current Agent turn to settle. Optional ratio/resolution fields add an explicit image output specification to the instruction. While a task is already running, this command performs a text-only steer with the frozen TaskScope kept unchanged and returns after acceptance; sourceNodeIds are then rejected and explicit attachment changes must use agent.steer. Every supplied sourceNodeId must still exist; a mixed valid/stale list fails before any Agent call.

commands.name: agent.goal
commands.description: Execute a Goal across either the exact sourceNodeIds or, when omitted, all eligible SOURCE image containers. Optional ratio/resolution fields add one explicit output specification for every generated image. Invoking this command is explicit authorization to dispatch image requests and accept upstream billing; no second fee confirmation is requested. operationsPerAsset freezes the number of requested operations for every eligible source asset. Before dispatch, naimage internally builds the complete preview, TaskScope and billing quote, issues and consumes a one-time authorization receipt, and rechecks canvas drift. Empty, generating, stale, reference-only, changed, or busy inputs fail before provider dispatch. The result includes the frozen request count, billing estimate, probe count, and concurrency cap, and the command waits for the current Agent turn to settle.

examples.prompt: 为每张母图生成两张方形商品图

commands.name: commerce.compose-set
commands.description: Compose and execute a deterministic cross-border commerce listing-set plan. platformTemplateId selects the built-in general, amazon, or aliexpress slot registry; explicit slots may then override the selected template one image at a time. In translate mode, translationItems applies a non-empty prompt to one exact zero-based sourceIndex and selected localeCode cell; duplicate, unselected, or out-of-range cells fail before dispatch. Invoking this command is explicit authorization to dispatch the resulting image requests and accept upstream billing; no second fee confirmation is requested. sourceNodeIds are exact and atomic, and the plan determines operationsPerAsset. naimage normalizes the plan, builds the complete frozen Goal preview, TaskScope and billing quote, then internally issues and consumes the same one-time authorization receipt used by agent.goal before dispatch. When a SOURCE mother image has one unambiguous active master relation in the project SKU catalog, that binding is frozen into the TaskScope and successful results are automatically filed to the matching product, variant, or SKU after the session is saved; ambiguous or changed catalog ownership is reported without deleting the generated images. The dispatch response includes frozen request, billing, probe, and concurrency metadata. Probe-first admission, progressive ramp-up, circuit protection, and duplicate-dispatch protection remain mandatory.

commands.name: agent.steer
commands.description: Change the active task, independently keep, replace, append, or clear SOURCE/REFERENCE attachments, persist a re-hashed TaskScope snapshot, interrupt the current phase, and return only after acceptance. sourceMode/referenceMode override the compatible taskScopeMode shorthand. Every supplied node ID must exist; replace/merge requires a non-empty corresponding ID list and never executes a valid subset of a stale request.

commands.name: agent.pause
commands.description: Pause dispatch at the next runtime boundary; an accepted upstream request may still finish.

commands.name: agent.resume
commands.description: Resume a paused task and fail the command if the runtime does not accept the resume.

commands.name: agent.stop
commands.description: Stop the active task while preserving completed results. Missing active work or a failed backend cancellation is a top-level command failure, never a successful idle response.

notes.title: Images and containers
notes.body: For generation, editing, variants, cutout, redraw, and layer work, select the intended sources and use `agent.chat`. The Agent preserves provenance and creates results through the same runtime as the GUI.

notes.title: Responses and errors
notes.body: Successful output is JSON with `ok: true` and `result`. Failures use `ok: false` and `error`. Retry a `rendererReady: false` status briefly. Never expose endpoint authorization data.

notes.title: Renderer lifecycle
notes.body: Every Agent run and pending automation command is owned by the Renderer that dispatched it. If that Renderer closes or crashes, naimage immediately rejects its pending CLI commands, aborts its run, and prevents further dispatch without affecting other Renderer owners. Provider requests already accepted upstream continue draining under Main-process admission and may still complete or incur charges. Application shutdown aborts all runs before transports are dismantled.

notes.title: Goal dispatch safety
notes.body: An explicit agent.goal or commerce.compose-set invocation authorizes upstream image charges. The Renderer still builds a complete preview and cryptographically random one-time receipt bound to the full request, frozen TaskScope, billing quote, active project, conversation, and issuing surface, then consumes it internally before dispatch. Changed inputs, stale scopes, changed costs, cancellation, and replay are rejected before provider dispatch. Goal execution uses the app's configured concurrency limit, but first serially probes 1-2 distinct SOURCE images, preferring different containers when available. Renderer windows share one Main-process Goal admission controller: queued probes take priority over new ramp waves, and admitted Goals fairly share the frozen process capacity. The app expands only after request acceptance, asset persistence, and result validation succeed; protected failures open a cross-Goal circuit. A bounded transport retry pauses every new ramp wave until the request settles, and closing a Renderer does not release its reservation until the real provider Promise drains. These safeguards stop only work that has not yet been dispatched. An upstream request already accepted by a provider may still complete and incur charges, so process-wide admission is not a cost guarantee.

notes.title: Commerce plan contract
notes.body: For commerce.compose-set, languageCodes and targetLocales are mutually exclusive and every language code must come from the canonical commerce language registry. Unknown languages or supplying both fields fails before plugin composition, the internal Goal preview, or provider dispatch. TranslationItems uses the exact SOURCE expansion order and may override only a selected image-language cell; its normalized prompts are included in the frozen plan hash and prompt-material fingerprint. The structured plan, exact SOURCE boundary, and any unambiguous project SKU Catalog destination are frozen into the one-time internal authorization receipt and cannot be changed after dispatch begins. Successful results are reconciled from the persisted session into the frozen product, variant, or SKU target; ambiguous ownership or a Catalog revision conflict leaves the image on the canvas and returns a retry/manual-filing warning.
